verdict.rationale: Unleash exposes an MCP server so external LLM-powered coding assistants can manage feature flags (unleash-docs-7, unleash-probe-2), but this is the reverse of the story — it lets outside AI agents call Unleash, not a built-in assistant embedded inside Unleash's own UI/product for users to delegate tasks to. No evidence of an in-product AI assistant, chat interface, or agentic feature inside Unleash itself.
